articles.title: Associated British Foods (LSE:ABF) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower After Analyst Target Revisions
articles.summary: Price target assumptions around Associated British Foods are being adjusted, with fair value estimates edging from £18.68 to £18.15 and individual targets clustering between about £15.50 and £19.50. These shifts align with more measured analyst commentary, as research houses reassess execution risks and segment trends while keeping many targets, including those from JPMorgan, in the mid teen to high teen range. In the sections that follow, you will see how this evolving narrative might matter...
